scope: Unified Linux Flutter app: camera/gesture preview and real application-local page backend. No external input integration.
startup: Read and verify already-exported latest model/calibration receipts; no training, re-export, camera opening or automatic control

verification.native_gesture_no_camera_smoke: passed: real Flutter/Python IPC, default stopped, page visible, stop keys, manual-tab round trip
verification.normal_app_model_selection: passed with current exported motion TCN and matching calibration; launcher intercepted before UI
verification.new_native_bridge_mlp_tcn: passed: programmatic contract simulation, enable/owner/rewarm, model-policy-local page 1 -> 2, no new page after stop

safety_boundaries: New UI command schema has no navigation, logits or class-input command
Camera, enable and neutral-owner selection are separate user actions
Mode switch waits for confirmed camera release; hide/inactive closes camera
Fresh original surface tokens, model evidence age and parent heartbeat checked separately
One worker until confirmed release, capacity-one frame slots, bounded private IPC
Synthetic models cannot acquire live application-local authority
No OS keyboard injection, recording, uploads or external PPT/WPS control
evidence_boundary: Positive gesture execution tests use the existing untrained analytical-network fixtures and in-memory provenance copies only, never exported as real models. This implementation/test work did not open a real camera, train a network or read final-test samples.
